name: asgardeo
description: Skill for managing Asgardeo end-to-end through the asg CLI — install and authenticate, manage applications, users, groups, roles, identity providers, API resources, scopes, branding, organizations, and agents, then integrate the matching Asgardeo SDK into your app.

interface.shortDescription: Add login and access control to apps, agents, and MCP servers with Asgardeo.
interface.longDescription: Skill for Asgardeo through the asg CLI. Install the CLI and log in, register apps and wire the Asgardeo SDK for login, SSO, social login, MFA, or passwordless sign-in, gate features and APIs by role and scope, give AI agents their own identity or act-on-behalf-of tokens, secure MCP servers with OAuth, manage users, groups, roles, identity providers, branding, and organizations, and diagnose failed logins and 403s.
defaultPrompt: Add Asgardeo login to my React app.
Only let admins call the orders API.
Give my AI agent its own Asgardeo identity.
